- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Gollum was torn between his loyalty to the Ring, which he referred to as "my precious" or "precious," and his love for his "master," Bilbo Baggins.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The character Gollum has become iconic and has been referenced and parodied in popular culture.
